prompt: Create an original 90 second instrumental synthwave instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: analog arpeggiator, synth bass, electronic drums. Style: steady retro pulse with luminous melodic synth phrases. Tempo approximately 114 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: An upbeat and driving electronic track featuring a prominent synth melody, pulsating bassline, and crisp electronic drums. It has a modern yet slightly retro feel, building energy throughout.
description.zh: 一首欢快且富有推动力的电子音乐，以突出的合成器旋律、脉动的低音线和清脆的电子鼓为特色。它具有现代感又略带复古气息，在整个过程中不断积蓄能量。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
